title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 在中国传统文化中，亲朋好友之间互赠礼物是人际交往的一种重要礼节 (etiquette) 。赠送礼物不仅是物质的馈赠，更是情感的表达，是维系人际关系的重要纽带。一份精心挑选、符合接受者喜好的礼物，往往能加深彼此的感情。中国人遵循"礼尚往来" (mutually exchanging courtesies)的传统，接受礼物时会表达谢意，并适时回赠礼物，以增进彼此的融洽关系。
reference: In traditional Chinese culture, exchanging gifts among relatives and close friends is an important form of etiquette in interpersonal communication. Giving gifts is not only a material offering, but also an expression of affection, and an important bond that maintains interpersonal relationships. Such a carefully chosen gift that suits the recipient's preferences can often deepen mutual affection. Chinese people follow the tradition of reciprocity (mutually exchanging courtesies): when receiving gifts, they express their gratitude and return gifts at an appropriate time, so as to enhance their harmonious relationship.
